requirement_text.REQ-070:
Replace lib/letflow/router.ex's single flat route table -- today GET /health plus a 404 catch-all, per its own moduledoc -- with the decomposed structure the rest of S4 mounts into. This resolves stage-4-api-surface.md's OQ-1.
The shape is per-subsystem sub-routers under an /api/v1 prefix, one module per R-Co route file group, delegated to from a top-level router: identity, instances, definitions, tasks, promotion, onboarding, audit, tenant_config, validation, health, metrics. Under Plug that is Plug.Router.forward/2 to a sub-router module per subsystem. REQ-065 settled the framework: Plug/Bandit stands (addendum 2026-08-20). This requirement MUST NOT re-open that choice.
GET /health MUST keep its current contract exactly -- 200 with {"status":"ok"}, no auth, no DB dependency -- because deploy/redeploy-test.sh's post-deploy check consumes it and a change breaks deployment, not just a test.
The unmatched-route response becomes REQ-066's 404 problem document rather than today's ad-hoc {"error":"not_found"} map.
The moduledoc MUST carry the deferred-route list: dlq, services, platform_migrations, webhooks (S6), simulation_test (S7), process_modules (S5), entities and entity_query (S5/S6), and the three agent_* routes (deferred), each with its owning stage.

WF-02 Step 2a — Backend implementation for REQ-070: Router decomposition into per-subsystem sub-routers.

Branch: feature/WF02-REQ070-20260821. Verify git branch --show-current == feature/WF02-REQ070-20260821 before touching any file.

Design reference: lib/letflow/design/req070-router-decomposition.md (CODE-DESIGN-VALIDATOR verified PASS at step 1b). Read it before coding.

== WHAT TO IMPLEMENT ==

1. REWRITE lib/letflow/router.ex — the top-level router:
   - use Plug.Router
   - plug(:match) and plug(:dispatch) only (no Plug.Parsers here — that lives in ApiPipeline)
   - GET /health — inline handler: 200 + {"status":"ok"} with no auth, no DB call. Use Letflow.Api.Response.send_json/3 or a direct conn pipeline. This is the existing contract; preserve it byte-for-byte.
   - forward "/api/v1", to: Letflow.Plugs.ApiPipeline — delegates all /api/v1/* to the shared pipeline
   - match _ catch-all → Letflow.Api.Response.not_found(conn) (RFC 9457 404)
   - @moduledoc must include:
     a) The 11-entry deferred-route table with owning stages: dlq(S6), services(S6), platform_migrations(S6), webhooks(S6), simulation_test(S7), process_modules(S5), entities(S5/S6), entity_query(S5/S6), agent_requests(deferred), agent_responses(deferred), agent_events(deferred)
     b) "Readiness endpoint (routes/health.zig handleReady / api/health/readiness.zig) is deliberately not ported — it needs S6 observability subsystem probes."
     c) "Executes docs/migration/decisions/0001-web-framework.md addendum (2026-08-20) — Plug/Bandit stands."

2. CREATE lib/letflow/plugs/api_pipeline.ex — Letflow.Plugs.ApiPipeline:
   - use Plug.Router
   - This is the SINGLE shared middleware declaration site
   - Plugs: Plug.Parsers (parsers: [:json], json_decoder: Jason, length: 2_097_152 — 2MB cap, state the justification in a comment), Letflow.Plugs.AuthPipeline (already built, REQ-021), Letflow.Plugs.TenantStatus (already built, REQ-021), plug(:match), plug(:dispatch)
   - Ten forward/2 calls for each sub-router (Letflow.Routers.Identity, etc.) at their respective path prefixes (strip the /api/v1 prefix since this module is already mounted at /api/v1):
     forward "/identity", to: Letflow.Routers.Identity
     forward "/instances", to: Letflow.Routers.Instances
     forward "/definitions", to: Letflow.Routers.Definitions
     forward "/tasks", to: Letflow.Routers.Tasks
     forward "/promotion", to: Letflow.Routers.Promotion
     forward "/onboarding", to: Letflow.Routers.Onboarding
     forward "/audit", to: Letflow.Routers.Audit
     forward "/tenant-config", to: Letflow.Routers.TenantConfig
     forward "/validation", to: Letflow.Routers.Validation
     forward "/metrics", to: Letflow.Routers.Metrics
   - match _ catch-all → Letflow.Api.Response.not_found(conn)
   - @moduledoc: explain this is the single shared middleware declaration site for all tenant-scoped sub-routers

3. CREATE lib/letflow/routers/*.ex — ten sub-router stub modules:
   - Letflow.Routers.Identity, .Instances, .Definitions, .Tasks, .Promotion, .Onboarding, .Audit, .TenantConfig, .Validation, .Metrics
   - Each: use Plug.Router, plug(:match), plug(:dispatch), match _ → Letflow.Api.Response.not_found(conn)
   - @moduledoc for each: "Stub sub-router for [subsystem] routes. Routes are added by [owning requirement(s)]. No routes are defined here yet."

== TOOLCHAIN NOTES ==
   - mix may not be on PATH bare; invoke "/c/Program Files/Elixir/bin/mix" quoted if needed
   - The Postgres container for this workspace is on LETFLOW_DB_PORT from ./.env (5482), its own container — do NOT run docker compose up (check if already running first with docker compose ps)
   - mix compile --warnings-as-errors must exit 0
   - No mix ecto.migrate needed — no DB changes
   - mix format --check-formatted — fix any formatting issues
   - Full mix test must pass

== SELF-REVIEW CHECKLIST ==
   [ ] No string interpolation of tenant/user input into raw SQL (INV-7) — not applicable here (no SQL)
   [ ] GET /health has no DB call — verify by reading the function body
   [ ] Single shared middleware chain site — verify by grepping for 'Plug.Parsers' and 'AuthPipeline' across lib/ — should appear in exactly one file (api_pipeline.ex)
   [ ] All ten sub-router stubs compile
   [ ] Existing router tests still pass
   [ ] mix compile --warnings-as-errors exits 0

Complete the handoff: status COMPLETED, result.status PASS, artifacts_out listing all new/modified files, next_action 'Route to SECURITY-REVIEWER (Step 2c)'. Commit all files by explicit path on branch feature/WF02-REQ070-20260821 (never git add -A).
